type.title: Type
type.description: Link type: supersedes, related_to, blocked_by, caused_by, reinforces

on_duplicate.title: On Duplicate
on_duplicate.description: Write doctrine: supersede replaces a colliding memory (keeping it archived with a supersedes link), skip surfaces the blocking id, add bypasses the collision check. Omit for legacy deduplicate behavior.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Conversation text to extract facts from

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: When True, return detailed extraction trace

document_at.title: Document At
document_at.description: ISO 8601 date for when the source content was created. Propagated to all extracted memories.

promotion_context.description: Untrusted repository promotion declaration; server authorization remains authoritative.

PromotionRequestContext.title: PromotionRequestContext
PromotionRequestContext.description: Untrusted client declaration carried alongside extraction input.

model.title: Model
model.description: New embedding model name (omit to re-embed with current model)

memory_id.title: Memory Id
memory_id.description: Memory ID the feedback applies to

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query that produced this result

search_id.title: Search Id
search_id.description: Optional ID grouping results from the same search

source_prefixes.title: Source Prefixes
source_prefixes.description: Optional union of boundary-safe source path prefixes

source_boundary.title: Source Boundary
source_boundary.description: Match source_prefix only at an exact path boundary

recency_weight.title: Recency Weight
recency_weight.description: Recency boost weight (0.0=off, 1.0=heavily favor recent). Only applies to hybrid search.

recency_half_life_days.title: Recency Half Life Days
recency_half_life_days.description: Half-life in days for recency decay (default 30).

feedback_weight.title: Feedback Weight
feedback_weight.description: Weight for feedback-based ranking signal (0=disabled, default 0.1)

graph_weight.title: Graph Weight
graph_weight.description: Weight for graph-based link expansion (0=disabled, default 0.1). When enabled, linked memories get a bonus score.

since.title: Since
since.description: Filter memories created/documented at or after this ISO 8601 date

until.title: Until
until.description: Filter memories created/documented at or before this ISO 8601 date

include_archived.title: Include Archived
include_archived.description: Include archived memories in search results

auto_intent.title: Auto Intent
auto_intent.description: Auto-detect temporal intent from query text. Set to False to disable.

reference_date.title: Reference Date
reference_date.description: Reference date for temporal intent detection (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source for the replacement; defaults to the original memory's source

events.title: Events
events.description: Event types to subscribe to (default: all)
